body:
Triage: **`pm:queue`** — a user-hit dead-end interaction on the platform-native gantt renderer, with three concrete fix directions; dispatchable.

- **Why queue, not finding**: the guard itself is correct, but users drawing a legitimate-looking dependency get zero feedback (no toast, no cursor, no console warning) and cannot learn the constraint — a today-hit usability defect on a shipped surface, not dormant drift. The client short-circuits before the PATCH, so the server's human-readable 422 reason (which the app already produces) never surfaces, and no public output path (`onBeforeDependencyCreate` reason) exists for the host to intervene.
- **Anchors** on `origin/main` @ `521a37b`: `packages/plugin-gantt/` is the landing package; the write-failure toast channel the body cites exists (`gantt.writeFailed` in the locale packs), confirming the renderer has a feedback channel that the illegal-link path simply never reaches.
- **Dup check**: no open card covers gantt link-rejection feedback (local filter over cached open lists; #4157 is the same view but a distinct defect — placeholder rendering; #4022 is code triplication).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**CLAIM** (objectui whole-repo seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`) — dispatched as the second half of the gantt pack with #4157 (same dev agent, same worktree `objectui-gantt-pack`; branch `claude/issue-4158-gantt-link-feedback`, stacked on #4157's branch if locale files overlap).

**Delegated scope ruling (veto window open): direction 1 of the card's three** — negative affordance during hover (not-allowed cursor + target outline) plus an explanatory per-reason toast on drop (new `gantt.link.rejected.*` keys through the full locale-pack discipline). Direction 2 (public rejection-reason API such as `onBeforeDependencyCreate` output) is an API-surface addition that deserves its own contract-shaped card if wanted — not a rider here; direction 3 is subsumed by 1.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4210, part 2 of the gantt pack, implementing the recorded direction-1 ruling exactly.

The structural core is right: `canReceiveLink`'s four-branch boolean became `classifyLinkTarget` returning WHICH branch refused, with the boolean derived from it — hover affordance and drop toast are two consumers of one verdict, so no second classifier exists to drift (the constraint the dispatch demanded). The inline-style choice carries its measured justification (the `cursor-not-allowed`/ring-alpha utilities are not emitted in the prebuilt components CSS — a class would pass a DOM test and render nothing in a browser). Host veto via `onBeforeDependencyCreate` stays silent BY DESIGN and is pinned as a control — that reason belongs to the host, i.e. direction 2's territory, correctly not smuggled in. Reverse verification predicted 7 red / 3 green and landed exactly, with the three greens being the intended controls. New `gantt.link.rejected.*` keys through the full ten-pack discipline (4 keys, all nine packs following, zero unexplained en drift).

**Merge order note (PM-held):** #4210 is STACKED on #4157's branch, so it has no CI by design (full local ladder quoted in its body). It stays as-is until PR #4205 lands; the seat will then retarget its base to `main`, verify mergeability, and flip ready + auto-merge. Finding #4209 (the `group` branch is unreachable today — group rows render no bar — plus the adjacent fact that the context-menu dependency picker creates links without consulting this policy at all) is graded: held as a finding for now; the picker-bypass half is real inconsistency but not silent corruption (the server guard still rejects), and it will ride the next gantt-area dispatch.
